info.name: Madhouse API — full client-derived request catalogue
info.description: Complete method/path catalogue found in the current public Mini App bundle. Response schemas are client-derived or explicitly unknown. The GET folder is read-only. The mutation folder is protected by a collection pre-request script; set allowMutations=true in the local environment only when deliberately sending a state-changing request.

item.name: State-changing operations — manual use only
item.description: POST, PUT and DELETE may change game/account state. The collection pre-request guard blocks these until allowMutations=true is deliberately set in the local environment. Do not run the full collection.
